title: Senior Data Scientist
description: Synthetic senior product role: frame business questions, build reproducible Python and SQL analyses, design experiments or credible causal studies, and explain uncertainty to product partners. Own measurement from hypothesis through review. Expected experience: at least 5 years of relevant applied data science or quantitative analysis.
screening_criteria: Build reproducible data analysis in Python.
Write SQL joins, aggregations and analytical queries.
Design and interpret controlled experiments or causal studies with statistical uncertainty.
At least 5 years of relevant applied data science experience.

questions.text: Walk through an experiment or causal study you owned. How did you define outcomes, check assumptions and explain uncertainty?
Describe a Python and SQL analysis you owned and how you checked its correctness.
Which quantitative analyses did you personally lead, and over what dates?

requirements.description: Build reproducible data analysis in Python.
Write SQL joins, aggregations and analytical queries.
Design and interpret controlled experiments or causal studies with statistical uncertainty.
At least 5 years of relevant applied data science or quantitative analysis experience.
Experience with dbt or reproducible warehouse transformations.
A quantitative degree or equivalent documented applied study.
